pool.text: The Turkic peoples first captured Smyrna under the Seljuk commander Çaka Bey.
The Byzantine commander John Doukas recaptured the city and the neighboring region.
The port city was captured by the Knights of St John.
A coalition of forces coordinated by Pope Clement VI took back the lower castle.
The upper city of İzmir was captured from its Aydinid rulers by the Ottomans.
Timur won the Battle of Ankara against the Ottomans, putting a check on their state.
Mehmet I took back İzmir for the Ottomans for the second time.
İzmir began to be one of the foremost trade centers of the Empire.
The Ege University was founded by the Turkish government in the city.
The sanctuary was registered as a protected area for water birds by the Ministry.
The annual International İzmir Festival has been organized every year since this date.
The İzmir European Jazz Festival is among the numerous events organized every year.
Coordinated public transportation was introduced to İzmir.
The discovery of Yeşilova Höyük reset the starting date of the city's past.
The Arkas Art Centre became one of the most venerable cultural hubs after acquisition.
Act 6360 established all thirty of İzmir Province's districts as part of the metropolitan area.
The Barış Youth Symphony Orchestra was founded incorporating children with limited opportunities.
İzmir Pride peaked by 50,000 participants as the second largest in Muslim-majority countries.
The city was damaged by the Aegean Sea earthquake and tsunami.
A new independent line in Çiğli was opened.
